name: Bamboo Harvest Batch
description: Chain-of-custody tracking for a physical lot of harvested bamboo (ERC-721) — a distinct instrument from bamboo-plot's fractional land ownership. Each batch is minted by the grower/cooperative once a lot is harvested, then transferred hop-by-hop as physical custody moves through processing and distribution: the current token holder is the current physical custodian, timestamped and anchored by the platform's existing audit trail. Roles map onto the platform's fixed role set: Issuer originates a batch (grower/cooperative), Trader represents any intermediate handler (processor, distributor), Buyer is the final holder (retailer or end consumer). Burning retires a batch once its bamboo is fully consumed/converted into an end product.

batchId.description: Registry identifier for this specific harvest lot — enforced unique so one physical lot is tokenized only once

sourcePlotAssetId.description: Asset id of the bamboo-plot this batch was harvested from

weightKg.description: Harvested weight of this lot, in kilograms

species.description: Bamboo species harvested, e.g. Bambusa balcooa, Dendrocalamus strictus

originGrower.description: Cultivating entity that harvested this lot — cooperative, farmer collective, or individual grower
